# Klepton-derived native OpenXR boot increment

This is a partial, non-conformant extraction: bootstrap dispatch, empty extension/layer enumeration, instance create/destroy and host-reported HMD availability and system properties, instance-owned semantic path interning, and action-set creation/destruction. The properties callback is optional and errors if absent; no Quest identity, graphics limits or tracking capabilities are fabricated. In ordinary builds the explicit serialized host boundary does not create a session or expose Metal, pose, input, spaces or frames. `xrCreateSession` returns an error. A separate `KL_NATIVE_TEST_METAL_PARTIAL` build exposes only a host-backed Metal resource/session slice for owned tests; it can pass a completed two-eye projection to an injected host callback; no actual platform presenter is connected. No xrizer integration or game/device claim follows. See `SOURCE.md` and the extraction research report for provenance, verification and limitations.

`./build-test.sh` builds and runs the owned macOS ARM64 boot fixture normally and with UBSan and tests production extension withholding and a Metal resource mock, and cross-compiles visionOS simulator/device archives; outputs are isolated under ignored `build/`. `KLEPTON_SANITIZERS=1 ./build-test.sh` additionally tries ASan+UBSan; the first attempt spun without completing and was interrupted, as documented in the report. No simulator or device is launched.

Parent isolation: UBSan-only boot fixture passes. ASan also stalls on an independent minimal `puts` control with leak detection disabled; its cause remains unresolved. See `evidence/sanitizer-isolation.json`. This does not turn the combined sanitizer attempt into a pass.
